description: This file defines a template-based registry system for object creation and registration, including macros for declaring and defining registries and registering classes or creators, primarily used within the c10 namespace of a PyTorch-related project.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: A template class that manages registration and creation of objects identified by keys, supporting priorities and help messages.

classes.name: Registerer
classes.description: Helper class for registering classes or creators into a Registry with optional priority and help message.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a creator function with a specified key and priority, with optional help message.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if a key is registered.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an object associated with a key, passing additional arguments.

methods.name: Keys
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered keys.

methods.name: HelpMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the help message for a given key.

methods.name: SetTerminate
methods.description: Sets whether the registry should terminate on errors.
